newsitem.title: USA: Magna Group Q1 operating net up 23.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Magna Group Q1 operating net up 23.3 pct.

text.p: Magna Group Inc said Wednesday that, excluding a one-time charge, its first quarter earnings rose 23.3 percent to $17.7 million, compared with year-ago results.
Earlier, Magna reported first quarter earnings of $9.4 million or $0.31 a share, after increasing its loan provision by $12.5 million. A year ago, it earned $14.3 million or $0.51 a share.

"While this charge impacted our short-term earnings, we believe this action is prudent under the present circumstances surrounding this loan," G. Thomas Andes, chairman, said in a statement. "This credit is secured with real estate and marketable securities, and we are taking immediate action to maximize our potential recovery."

For the first quarter, excluding the one-time charge, the return on equity from core earnings was 13.61 percent, compared with 12.69 percent a year ago. Including the charge, the first quarter return on equity was 7.26 percent.
